passive.name: Pyromania
passive.text: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.text: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.text: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

spells.name: Molten Shield
spells.text: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

spells.name: Summon: Tibbers
spells.text: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

damage.value: Annie deals burst fire damage with Q, W, and R, while Tibbers adds sustained damage to nearby enemies.

archetype.value: Annie is a scaling mage who blows up squishy targets in teamfights.

axis.value: Annie should avoid heavy trades early, conserve mana, and play for her level 6 power spike.

winCondition.value: Annie wins by making picks that lead to objectives and by blowing up squishy targets in teamfights.

spikes.why: Annie gains a power spike that shapes her early laning plan.
Annie can get lane priority with max-rank W and make plays around the map.
Annie begins the game and respawns with a stun ready for her next offensive spell.

bait.why: After Annie casts Molten Shield, its shield, Move Speed burst, and retaliatory damage are unavailable until its 10-second cooldown ends.
After Annie summons Tibbers, she cannot summon him again until his cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Annie can run out of mana by trading too heavily early.
Annie is heavily punished for poor spacing in lane or teamfights.
Annie loses Q's Mana refund if Disintegrate does not destroy its target.
